brief:
Ramallah hosted a session discussing national feminist policy aimed at strengthening Palestinian women's resilience in the context of occupation, according to Maan Wire. The forum brought together stakeholders to address how policy frameworks can support women facing challenges under Israeli control.

The initiative reflects efforts by Palestinian civil society and governance bodies to center women's experiences and agency within broader resistance and survival strategies during prolonged conflict.
title: Palestine launches discussion on national feminist policy to bolster women's resilience
